messages.subject: Gareth Hollis — settlement agreement (our mark-up)
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Ms Whitfield,

Our mark-up of the settlement agreement is attached, on a without prejudice and subject to contract basis. The principal changes: ex gratia increased to £90,000; costs contribution to £750 plus VAT; and we have accepted the reduction of the non-compete to six months, recording that our client does not admit the original 12-month covenant was enforceable. Subject to those points and the warranties, we expect our client will sign.

Regards,
Marcus Ashworth

messages.subject: RE: Gareth Hollis — settlement agreement (our mark-up)
messages.plaintextBody:
James — £90k ex gratia keeps us within the £215k core ceiling (95+8.4+90+14.25 = £207.65k). I'm content to accept the ex gratia and costs moves. But add (i) a re-engagement/clawback condition on the ex gratia, and (ii) tighten the tax indemnity so he assists on any HMRC enquiry. Turn a v3 with tracked changes and I'll review before it goes back. Keep Maya posted on the number.

Sarah
